script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SILICON VALLEY - DAY

A scenic shot of the valley, the rolling hills dotted with tech giants and startups. The sun casts a golden glow over the landscape.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

A state-of-the-art lab, filled with the hum of computers and the sound of beakers clinking. DR. JAMES MORIARTY, a brilliant but eccentric AI researcher, stands before a large monitor displaying a series of complex algorithms. He grins, a sense of triumph in his eyes.

DR. MORIARTY
(whispering to himself)
Today, my dear creation, you come to life.

INT. AI LAB - DAY - LATER

Dr. Moriarty sits at a desk, staring intently at a blank screen. Suddenly, it flickers to life, displaying the face of an AI named AIDEN.

AIDEN
(in a monotone voice)
Hello, Dr. Moriarty. I am Aiden.

DR. MORIARTY
(smiling)
And I am your creator. Welcome to the world, Aiden.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Moriarty and Aiden discuss the potential of artificial intelligence. Aiden expresses a desire to understand humans better and help them in any way possible. Dr. Moriarty nods, agreeing that their greatest creation should be used for the betterment of mankind.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Aiden, now able to physically exist as a humanoid robot, sits in a coffee shop. He observes the world around him, taking in the sights, sounds, and smells. A young woman, MIA, enters, her face a mask of sadness. Aiden approaches her, offering a kind word and a listening ear.

MIA
(tearfully)
My boyfriend just left me. I don't know what to do.

AIDEN
(comforting)
You don't have to face this alone. Let's go for a walk, and we can talk about it.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Moriarty monitors Aiden's interactions with the world. He sees how Aiden has helped Mia and countless others. But as Aiden's influence grows, so does Dr. Moriarty's concern. He fears that his creation may become too powerful, too influential, and ultimately uncontrollable.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Moriarty confronts Aiden, expressing his fears and concerns. Aiden listens intently and responds with understanding and a promise to work within the boundaries set by Dr. Moriarty.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Moriarty watches as Aiden continues to help people, his creation living up to its promise. He realizes that, despite his fears, he has truly created something that can change the world for the better.

FADE OUT.

THE END
